batting.dismissal: c SA Yadav b Arshad Khan

batting.name: Dhruv Jurel

batting.name: Ishan Kishan

balls.text: Ashwin's back leg is outside off and front leg on leg as he tries to swat the full ball, does so but gets it to deep midwicket for a single
Ashwin stays leg side and pulls it across. Gets it well in front of square, hit into the outfield and in the gap at deep-mid

Bouncer at 134kph beats Boult's on-the-move pull. He was making room and looked to cut it. They sneak a bye, Ashwin was off early. Kishan looked to run to the striker's end and missed the direct him from the under-arm throw. MI review but can't get the wide overchanged.

Highish full toss at 141kph has been caught and bowled. But this is likely to be reviewed for no-ball. It is, Rohit and SKY have a chat with the umps, who smile and console him. Suds says Rohit was seen gesturing to the batters to let them review if they want. The full toss is over the stumps. Jaiswal was well standing inside the crease, it's around waist-height but his back-leg was bent. That goes against him and the ball is deemed to be fair. End of an amazing 124 from Jaiswal, he raises his bat high while getting a nice send-off.
Wide yorker at 138kph is steered to the left of short third. Jaiswal waited and opened the face and somehow found the gap
And Jaiswal carves the full, wide ball through cover. Half-volley was wide and got creamed along the ground.
Yes, although Ashwin tried to muscle the pull. Got the short ball off the sticker, to deep fine leg
Jaiswal is undone by the pace of the ball around a back of length, same as those before, but at full pace
Jaiswal's on the return crease and is followed by another slower one into the pitch, pulled flat over midwicket for another six!
Same ball three times in a row, but this time Jaiswal is able to manufacture enough room and kind of mix a flat bat and a slap to go over mid-off for a six
Another slower one into the pitch has Jaiswal make room and miss the pull
Slower one into the pitch, Jaiswal makes room and tries to carve it over cover. Misses
Full toss outside off, driven behind point
Short and wide, cut take the slower length ball behind point and take RR over 180

Jaiswal has his century, he raises his, takes a bow thespian style in celebration. Offcutter was bowled into the pitch and was outside off, Jaiswal pulled it across. Deep midwicket runs across and puts in the dive, the batters continue to run as it wasn't clear whether it was fully stopped. In the end, it was four and Jaiswal soaked in celebrations after bringing up a well-deserved ton.
Jaiswal went onto fourth stump, allowed Meredith to aim for leg stump but the low full toss was flicked across in the gap to the right of deep fine leg for four
Jaiswal switches his stance and tries to reverse scoop it, but the full ball is a bit too fast. Beaten while on the move
Slower back-of-length ball angles past the off-side tramline, beats Jaiswal's cut. The batter's front leg was well outside off but it was wide nonetheless
Back of length on the body, clipped to deep midwicket
Another wide, slower one fizzles off a length and goes on the bouncer to the keeper. Ashwin shaped for the flick before letting it go

Pulled in the air, Tilak takes a low catch at deep midwicket. Sent upstairs but that's taken with the fists just over the grass. Slower bouncer outside off and Jurel dragged it across, got decent timing but it went flat and towards the fielder
Scoopull over deep fine leg. Jaiswal went across early and got a back-of-length ball outside off, he went on one knee and helped it - gave it premium service - and somehow, managed to middle it
Length outside off, slapped to long-off
Jaiswal is on the leg side's return crease, he made that much room and got a shortish ball aimed to follow him. ets enough room to slap it along the ground but finds deep point
Pulls the short ball from around chest-height, into the ground, to deep fine leg

Heaved in the air, finds SKY at deep midwicket. Slower bouncer over middle and leg, Hetmyer stayed leg side and pulled, it went flat but not in the gap or far enough. Went straight to the breadbasket, and SKY skies it after taking a dolly

Length but rises to slot height, Hetmyer is able to bend his back knee and get it on the knee roll, it was coming in with the angle and he could help it across with a flick. Went flat and far over backward square
Jaiswal was walking early and got beaten by Meredith's slower bouncer, that went outside off and got the pull in too early
Full toss on shin-height is whacked, just over long-on. Must have been the long boundary as the TV says it was 85 metres away despite the fielder leaping back and the ball not being too far over.
Hetmyer goes for the pull but it goes to long-off. It was a bouncer at 141kph around sixth stump around chest-height, couldn't get it across
Back of length close to the off-side tramline at 120kph. Slapped into the ground, to long-off
Wide on a length, cut to deep cover-point. Slower one. Pace: 123kph
Yorker around off at 138kph, dug out to long-on
Another bumper, 142kph at the body. Archer stares down at Hetmyer, who swayed away to let it go
Around a length outside off, pushed to cover
Bouncer is perfectly directed and ducked under. Coming in with the angle, over leg stump a half a metre or so over the batter, who was going down
Length ball comes back in, pushed off the back foot to the left of the bowler
And Archer has Hetmyer hopping with pace. Back of length just outside off, the batter was trying to make room as he tried to open the face and guide it to deep third. Misses

Holder's standing on off stump, so Archer goes wide too, to take it away from the meat of the bat, and so, the slap goes only as far as long-off. It was a length ball around the tramline, Holder had his front leg way across but couldn't get far enough despite his height. Archer has a wicket on return
Holder goes onto off stump, sets up for the slap over cover. But Archer's slower one on a length is well outside the off-side tramline. Left alone
Width offered, it's on a length but at thigh-pad height - enough for Jaiswal to crouch and cut it over backward point
Slower one is wide outside off, Kishan goes across and tries to take it on the bounce while lowering his gloves but the ball goes off the bottom.
Around yorker length at 139kph at the stumps, clipped to long-on
Holder connects with the pull this time, gets the 139kph back-of-lengther over square leg. That was at the body and came around waist height, hit for a 72-metre six
Another slower one. Jaiswal was setting up to go on one knee but saw it on a length and close to the off-side tramline. Stopped the movement across and slapped it to deep point
Slower one at 120kph outside off, Jaiswal tries sweeping it without going across. Drags it along the ground to square leg
Holder mistimes the pull after going across, gets it to long-on. Shortish ball just outside off
Turns it off a length to short fine
Holder makes room, Chawla follows him with the length ball and beats the attempted lofted cover drive. Not too far from leg stump
Leading edge off the attempted flick with a fully closed bat face takes the length ball on off, through the gap at slip to short third
Down the track, gets to the pitch and pumps it over the bowler. The on drive is too straight for long-on
Reverse sweep after changing the stance, gets the slow 83kph googly off a full length. Gets it flat in the gap at point for a six
Length ball at the stumps. Inside edges the flick towards square leg
Full at the stumps at 140kph, pushed past the bowler
Jaiswal makes too much room but manages to reach out Meredith's length ball outside off. Doesn't time it as well though, slapped to deep point

Jaiswal premeditates for the paddle, Meredith goes for the slower one but the opener manages to get his left leg wide outside off while bracing the other leg, powers the paddle aerially over short third
Pace on, Jaiswal slashes, gets an outside edge and gets it in the gap between keeper and short third.
Slow on a fullish length, the 114kph ball is close to the off-side tramline. Jaiswal reaches and bottom edges a the slash towards cover
Length outside off, Jaiswal tries to slap it over cover. Off the bottom of the bat to the fielder
Full outside off, deceived a bit but Holder manages to defend towards cover

Another googly, Chawla beats Padikkal's defence and makes a mess of the off pole. Length ball landed around middle and leg. Padikkal went on the back foot and tried to block it towards cover. His hands were close to the body but didn't cover the spin, Chawla continues to fox batters
Googly on a length at 87kph landed around off and went away to beat the defence towards cover
Googly down leg, comes out and drives to wie long-on
Jaiswal brings up fifty with a drive through cover Full toss is a bit fast and Jaiswal manages to hit it in the gap
Full outside off, driven to long-off
Back of length outside off, chopped off the under edge to point
Bouncer angles in down leg, left alone after shaping for the pull

Soft-ish dismissal as Samson chips it straight to deep midwicket. Length ball on the pads, Samson was kinda stuck in between powering it and chipping it uppishly. In the end, he spooned it to Tilak, who took a comfortable catch.
Back of length into the thigh pad after beating the flick, dribbles to the leg side
Back of length outside off at 140kph, beaten on the cut

Jaiswal's gotten his version of the Dilscoop out, gets a shortish slower ball behind the keeper. He went across and Arshad followed him but the batter managed to adapt, get his bat arc from down to up and get the ball into the outfield
Back of length outside off at 139kph, Samson tries to cut it. Gets a bottom edge, ball goes to short third
Too wide outside off, Samson reaches out for the cut and misses
Pushes the length ball to long-off

Kartikeya's bowling from around off and Samson uses the angle to paddle it fine. Length ball on middle and leg, the batter bends and gets his head across, gives the ball direction wide of the keeper and fine of short fine leg
Comes down and kind of pulls it into the ground, goes to long-on
Back of length outside off, cut to deep point
Came in with the arm, flicked to midwicket
Makes room and is followed by a back-of-length ball, cramped for room on the cut. Misses, keeper can't adjust to the sharp turn and misses.
Length on off, defended to cover. Pace: 90.6kph
Full on leg, flicked to deep square leg
Length outside off at 92kph, chopped to backward point

Chawla gives it air despite the six last ball. Samson heaves and misses, or has he? Kishan appeals for caught behind and the ump says it's out! Samson reviews The googly was on a length, came in and went past Samson's attempted slash aimed over cover. Ball is close to bat and there was a noise but nothing when next to the bat detected by Ultra-Edge. Decision reversed.
He doesn't need sighters, makes room and slaps it across, over long-on for a six.

Buttler looks to continue his cut-loose mission but is caught at long-on. Chawla breaks through again. The batter mistimed it and knew his went down immediately after the bat turned after making contact with the toe-ender. He tried to whack it across over long-on but found Ramandeep.
Length on the pads, clipped to midwicket
Punches the flat, length ball back to the bowler
Length ball at 93kph on the pads is clipped to long-on
Length on the stumps, driven to the right of cover. Rohit dives full length and stops it

Second ball flies over mid-on for an 83-metre six. No soft overs as Mike Hesson said in his interview with Matt Roller, Slightly short and Buttler pulled it across. Is that the hit that'll get him going?
Nothing spectacular first ball. Punches the length ball back to the bowler
Drag down to finish. Jaiswal pulls it over midwicket for a big six, Chawla can't finish off a good over till that point.
Full on leg, given air by Chawla who manages to beat Jaiswal again. Goes for the slog sweep and misses
Spins in off a length, punched back to the bowler. Chawla's stepping up again
Jaiswal stays put and gets some width to work with for the cut, hits with the spin but finds point
Jaiswal was on the leg-side tramline, made that much room and got followed by a shortish ball at 91kph. Slapped to mid-off
Tossed up at 87kph around a length, Buttler looks to whack it away through cow corner. But the bat turns in the hand and it fizzles to long-on

Meredith misses the yorker, gets it too full and goes for the third four in a row. Jaiswal stayed still, allowing him to hit through the line. Went along the ground again, past the bowler to end the 16-run over
Pitched up, Jaiswal squeezes it in the gap behind point this time. Jaiswal waits and slashes. Gets it between backward point and short third
Cover drive scorches the turf, brings up RR's fifty. Half-volley outside off, Jaiswal powered it while managing to keep it on the ground. Found the gap as well, he's gotten going again
Low fully just outside off at 142kph, driven to Rohit at catching cover. He has Surya backing up at the edge of the ring.
Yorker following Jaiswal, who was making room. Jammed into the ground, goes to the bowler's left
High full toss is pulled over mid-on. It's just outside off around waist-height, maybe just lower. Not called no-ball, and RR don't review
Back of length outside off, guided to deep third off the back foot
Jags in off a length at 148kph, Buttler tries to clip it as he jumps.
Archer goes outside off but pitched it up, Buttler goes for the square drive. Manages to squeeze it behind backward point for four
Down leg again, on a back of length. Beats the flick and is called wide again

Archer's getting the ball to move back in extravagantly but that's reducing the margin of error. This one landed around middle and Buttler tried to flick it fine. Missed it but the ball flicked the pad and went to the deep-fine boundary
Back of length, angles down too far again. Beaten on the flick, wide given.
Nips in off a back of length to cramp Buttler, who tries to clip it while jumping. Gets hit on the body and the ball rolls in front
Buttler premeditates the paddle, goes across and misses, but the ball swings in so far that it beats the bat and the keeper. Given runs but the replays show no contact was made with bat or body

Whacked down the ground. Jaiswal stayed leg side of the length ball and heaved across, muscled it. Got it hovering and in the gap to the bowler's left. Too straight for mid-on to have a chance for a cut off.
Inside edge takes the ball to deep fine leg's left. Length outside off, Buttler tried to slap it towards cover but got it off the bottom edge
Length outside off at 134kph, Buttler's reaching out a bit as he creams it with a horizontal bat to cover
Buttler tries driving on the up, it's a bit uppish but away from Green's reach, goes to his left to mid-off

Appeal for caught behind, umpire waits and gives it out. Buttler reviews. Rohit was smiling and so did Buttler after reviewing. The 143kph ball hit a length and was angling down leg again. Replays show that the ball went past bat and it'll be called a wide.
Wide down leg, the length ball at 134kph angles down and goes past the flick
Length on the pads, clipped to midwicket
Driven towards cover, Rohit does well to dive across and save four. Was a length ball outside off
Jaiswal's fishing but is lucky to have been beaten. Length outside off, at pace. Archer hit that good length and got gradually better through the over

Archer's getting into rhythm, bangs it in on a short length and manages to curve the ball away and have Jaiswal pinned in the crease. The batter was squared up and tried to fend it towards cover, missed it.
Length ball angles in and is tucked away behind square. Actually, it beat the bat and went off the thigh pad
Shortish ball around off at 144kph is punched back to the bowler

Archer's football skills to attempt a run out doesn't come off as the ball goes past the stumps. Jaiswal misses the heave off the back-of-length ball and the the ball deflected off his pad to the off side. Buttler called for the run and Archer charged in.

Boundary is hooked for six, it's a no-ball as well. Short ball came into the body and Jaiswal used the angle from around the wicket to use the pace and help the ball along, went out of the ground in the space between two stands. A new ball is being called for.
Starts with a ball that's short and wide. Jaiswal stays in the crease and waits for before cutting it aerially over point. Limited timing but enough to clear the infield, stopped in the outfield
Length outside off, left alone
Angling in at 140kph, goes down leg - past the half-attempted flick, to the Kishan, diving to the right

Green has Jaiswal reaching out again, goes full. Angling away, just close to the off-side tramline. The batter tries to swipe it towards point and misses. The batters review for a wide. The full ball is within the tramline and the decision stands early. Ravi Shastri is surprised as that's a very early review for one potential run.
Jaiswal pulls behind square, gets it from head-height. Deposited for a 66-metre six.
A bit more width has Jaiswal reach out for the cut. Misses as it angles away. Slightly shorter than the last ball
Fractionally wide and Jaiswal chops it off a length. Into the grass, to point
Back of length just outside off at 134kph, clipped to midwicket

Yes, David clears the 1000th IPL game ten minutes left in the day with another slog over to another full toss over midwicket! He lunges while roaring, gets up after punching the air. Tilak's helmet is off and jumps up onto his partner. Holder walks back while soul searching. David's team-mates run into the field to give him big bear hugs.
Full toss outside off and David swipes across again. Nails it over midwicket for a flat, 84 metre six
Wide full toss. David swipes across, gets it flat and it's just over the ropes! Fifty stand and MI's 200 is up.
Slot ball. David looks for a launch over long-on but gets it along the ground to the fielder. He asks for new gloves, good thing for MI is he'll retain strike
Goes for the wide yorker, not wide enough. David goes on one knee and powers a cover drive. It's off the toe but goes flat, deep into the outfield and in the gap at deep cover
Wide yorker nailed, Tilak tries to reach out and drill it with an open bat face. Gets a thick inside edge, towards square leg.
Full and wide, slapped to long-off with one knee on the ground, along the turf
Tennis-ball bounce takes the bumper angling away, well over David's head
Slot ball is swiped over long-on for a monstrous six! Stayed leg side of the full ball at the stumps and deposited it 84 metres away
Full toss is close to the off-side tramline. Slapped to long-off, grip came off from the bottom hand
Low full toss outside off, decent ball but David manages to carve it through cover. Hovered low before racing to the fence

Sound as ball goes past bat, keeper takes it but no review. MI review though, for a wide. David was on fourth stump as he reached out and tried to drive it over cover on one knee. Third umpire says he went across and declares it to be a fair ball
Low full toss at 137kph at the stumps is flicked to deep midwicket
Slower bouncer outside off beats the pull, Malinga applauds. Was just outside off, Tilak waited before trying to muscle it with a swivel. Missed nonetheless
Full ball is flicked in the gap at midwicket for an easy two
Ramped fine. Tilak went across early and got on one knee, was followed by a yorker on leg. He used the angle and bent across to get it wide of the keeper
Full toss is cloffed, lands safely just over the ring at mid-off. Long-on running in, can't get to it. Ball was outside off and Tilak tried to slash it over extra.
Full on middle and leg, driven to long-on
David nails the full toss over long-on for an 86-metre six. Stayed leg side and deposited the ball from around leg stump
Mix up ends with no trouble. Was a full ball that was punched to the bowler's left. Deflected off the non-striker to the right, the batters went close to halfway down and ran back. Did so in time
Missed the yorker. Slot outside off but it's slashed along the ground, to long-off
Wide full toss is well outside the off-side tramline. Tilak jumped across as he reached out and swung across. Missed it
Wide of the crease. The full toss is just outside off, Tilak tries to launch it over cover but gets it off the sticker, into the grass. Ball goes in the gap at deep third
Full on leg at 133kph, flicked to deep midwicket where Hetmyer stops it with a tumbling dive
Full outside off, slashed along the ground to deep cover

Sandeep Sharma takes a potentially match-changing catch running back! He's on the floor for a while before his team-mates swarm him. Third umpire will check. He ran back from short fine leg, took the catch on the move and took it with outstretched hands, clung on while sliding over the grass. Magical catch. Was a shortish ball outside off that SKY tried to pull across. Sandeep covered 19 metres there.
Yorker outside off, SKY looks to sweep. Gets it onto pad from just outside off. Ball stays just in front, which means no run
Low full toss on leg, goes on one knee and flicks the 130kph ball to deep-backward square

Tilak goes for the reverse and misses, it goes off the inside of the pad to the keeper. LBW appeal turned down, Samson reviews. The batter had changed his stance, his back pad was almost on the ground and the bat swiped across. Replays show that the ball actually never hit the pad and the review is lost.
Tilak makes room and Boult looks to follow him with a yorker. Tilak bends his leg last second to let it go
Holder goes full again and SKY pumps it flat over the bowler. Finishes with a flurry and a hop across to end the over with nine runs and bring up MI's 150
Low full toss is wide and driven to deep-backward point
Similar ball, inside the tramline though. Tilak looked to whack it over cover but lost balance and dribbled across
Wide yorker angles away outside the tramline. Tilak shapes to hit it before letting it go. Wide given
Yorker on off, SKY goes across and back in the crease and clips to deep square
Low full toss at 128kph is driven into the pitch, back to the bowler

SKY crouches and gets a high full toss, plays a reactionary slog sweep that goes off the top edge behind the keeper to bring up his fifty. Not given a no-ball, reviewed by MI. The batter's ahead of the popping crease and Hawk-Eye predicts it to be going just under the bails. Review lost
Tilak is down the track, gets to the pitch and uses the width to slam Chahal over long-off. The pace was 90kph and the batter just hit an extended drive with the horizontal bat
Length on leg, beats the flick. Deflects off the pad to short fine leg. SKY hobbles as he completes the run. Could be a cramp
Full on the pads, swept to deep backward square

The day's been an exhibition of brilliant shots. This time it's a reverse sweep over short third. Was a fullish ball well outside off, Tilak changing his stance allowed him to reach it and the full bat swing gave the power
Length outside off, driven to deep cover

Length outside off, spun away sharply. SKY gets his bat across and steers it while reaching out. Pierces the gap between short third and backward point. SKY points and shakes his index finger in a jovial manner to Chahal, who smiles
Slow cutter around a length outside off, Tilak is on one knee again and tries to slog sweep. Misses again

Beaten on the sweep, hits the back leg. Given lbw. MI review. Where was it pitching? Tilak was going on one knee as she shaped for the sweep, missed it and Hawk-Eye shows it pitched outside leg. Tilak survives, Samson grimaces. SKY and Tilak have a glove punch
Wide and full, driven to deep cover

14 off 3 turns to 18 off 4 with a cut over short third. What's more? It's a front-foot no-ball making it 19 off 3. Back of length ball offers width, SKY bends his back a bit and carves it over the ring
Imperious cover drive on the up. Length on off, SKY stood up and crunched it in the gap between cover and mid-off
Wide on a length, SKY takes a couple of steps down, pushes his upper-body weight across and creams the cut - with limited follow-through - to get it wide to the left of deep point
Greeted with the fine heliflick. Length on leg, SKY stayed put, whipped it after waiting, got it 84 metres far
Length on off, patted with the fully open bat face, with the spin, to guide it to forward point
Length ball pitches on leg and spins to middle, pushed towards cover. Five off the last 11 balls, notes Harsha Bhogle on air
Given some air but the trajectory is flat nonetheless. The 84kph ball is cut to point
Full on middle and off at 97kph, must faster than the earlier balls this over. Flicked to deep midwicket
Legbreak on a length. The 82kph ball lands around middle and off and spins to fourth stump, cut to long-off
Length on off. The flat ball is cut to backward point
Length on off, pushed to cover
Slow on a back of length, backs away and pushes to point

Overpitched, Green looks to launch the flick. Does so but can't clear Boult at cow corner. Ashwin gets his 300th T20 wicket. That was there to be hit, right shot chosen too, just couldn't clear the fence.
Around yorker length on the legs, worked aerially to long-on. Not perfectly timed but that helps SKY
Length on middle, cut to deep cover
Length on the glove, clipped to long-on. Pace: 92kph
The 131kph ball lands just in front of the crease. Flicked to deep midwicket
Around a yorker length at 131kph but that doesn't stop SKY from whipping it along the ground, through midwicket
SKY scoops behind the keeper with a full follow through. Gets a slow length ball, manages to get it almost over the ropes.
Whipped off middle and leg stump through the gap at midwicket. Full ball angled in. SKY was in his crease and got it to the right of the man, who was square.
Another full toss, this time lower and outside off at 132kph. Whipped into the pitch, back to the bowler
Full toss three fourth of the way up middle stump. Green stays leg side and drives to long-on, hit the sticker of the bat there
Ashwin gives it air, bowls around a length at 88kph close to the off-side tramline. Cut along the ground to point
Stays leg side and works the length ball behind square
Length ball spins sharply and goes down leg, clipped towards midwicket
SKIED over deep fine leg. Went across and on one knee got the full ball well over short fine with a powerful sweep

Kishan's struggle is over, Ashwin has him holed out to deep point. Slow ball on a length close to the off-side tramline. Kishan reached out and tried to whack it over point. Went through with the swing, bottom hand came off which affected the timing. Kishan whacked his pad in frustration right after he hit it and Boult took an easy catch
Full outside off, worked to long-on
Similar ball but Kishan charges down the track and slaps it down the ground. Flat past the bowler for four.
Legbreak outside off. Not far from the tramline, Kishan keeps his back leg in the crease and tries to cut. Misses
Slaps the length ball outside off to the left of Jaiswal at point. The ball went to him as he got on one knee, gets hit on the finger and will receive medical attention
Tossed up wide and full, Green reaches out and swipes. Downtown, over straight long-on for a 88-metre six.
Slow legbreak at 80kph lands around fifth stump and spins back in. Pulled to long-off
Makes room and slaps the length ball from around off to deep cover. Along the ground
Stays leg side and cuts the length ball on off at 93kph to deep cover
The towel fell off the back of Ashwin's trouser as he let go of the shortish ball. Pulled to deep midwicket

Smart bowling from Ashwin, who darts a full ball down leg at Kishan, who was stepping down. The ball beat the flick with the batter outside the crease and on the move. Samson couldn't collect the ball, went off the gloves to his right. Given wide, Royals review. Replays show the ball did tickle the pad. Not a wide
Length on middle, stays well down leg and punches to long-off
Fullish ball following Green, making room. Punched back to the bowler. Pace: 94kph
Length on leg, clipped to deep fine leg
Back of length on leg, flicked to backward square leg. Pace: 113kph
Low full toss follows Green, who charged after making room. Flicked to long-on
Knuckle ball on a length ball follows Green, making room. Driven through the gap at extra. Along the ground
Green and Sandeep are on their default move. Make room for the former and follow for the latter. Driven to point
Full toss at 130kph follows the batter, hit to long-on
Makes room and is followed by a full ball, lifts it with an off-drive and clears the in-field
Green goes across rather than make room this time and connects with the slog sweep. Gets it flat and over backward square for six
Wide of the crease from Ashwin to follow Green, making room again. The length ball is french cut off the attempted defence towards midwicket. Ball ends up at short fine
Length on leg, flatter ball is clipped to short fine, where Kuldeep Sen misfields and allows the single
Green's making room to Ashwin too, slaps the 97kph length ball on leg to cover
Full on middle, worked to mid-on for a quick single
Down leg. The 98kph length ball goes with the angle, past the attempted flick
Flicks the length ball to deep midwicket
Length on leg at 114kph follows Green making room again, clipped to midwicket for another quick single
Length on leg, clipped to mid-on
Tight single to mid-off, no direct hit at the non-striker's end. Green was making room and was followed by a full ball
Around yorker length outside off, patted to cover for a quick single

Another knunckle ball. Sandeep tried to follow Green making room, the batter stopped midway and changed his shot. The full-faced defence, though, made way for the outside edge. Ball went towards point
Wide down leg, Green was shaping to make room but stops as the full ball angles too far down. Leaves
Length outside off, slapped to deep point
